notes: Covers phase-05 Steps 7-13 directly against the new MC_READING_SINGLE/WRITE_ESSAY cubits and widgets: (1) McReadingSingleCubit.selectOption payload-shape assertion against a mocktail-mocked AnswerOutboxDao, asserting the captured payload is the literal decimal-string orderIndex ('2', '5', '12') and never the list position, ruling out an off-by-one list-index-vs-orderIndex bug; (2) WriteEssayCubit.draftChanged payload-shape assertion for 'hello world' producing an exact, untrimmed 'hello world' payload on debounce expiry; (3) debounce behavior driven entirely by a fake DebounceScheduler mirroring TimerService's _CapturingScheduler pattern -- rapid draftChanged calls produce zero upsertAnswer calls until the captured callback is invoked manually, and flushPendingEdit mid-debounce produces the upsert immediately without ever invoking the scheduled callback; (4) WriteEssayScreen's TextEditingController lifecycle verified via an executed widget test that tears the screen out of the tree and confirms no FlutterError/exception is thrown; (5) countWords tested as a pure function independent of any widget pump, covering empty string, whitespace-only, multiple spaces, leading/trailing whitespace, and tab/newline separators; (6) TaskAdvanceButton verified to call cubit.flushPendingEdit() then syncEngine.flushOne(pinnedItemPublicId) exactly once per tap (verifyInOrder-equivalent via an ordered fake-cubit call log plus mocktail verify), plus a double-tap-guard regression test; (7) WordCountLabel's BlocSelector rebuild-avoidance verified by mirroring exam_app_bar_test.dart's exact widget-identity-comparison pattern -- a state change with a different draftText but identical wordCount leaves the rendered Text instance identical, while an actual wordCount change produces a new instance -- plus coverage that being outside min/max bounds never renders an error state (guidance-only, per Design Constraints). Also added an executed widget test confirming TaskTypeDispatcher's ValueKey(pinnedItemPublicId) forces Flutter to construct a brand-new McReadingSingleCubit instance when consecutive same-type tasks have different pinnedItemPublicId values (and reuses the same instance when the key is unchanged), guarding the exact stale-state defect the key was added to fix. One test-infrastructure note: an initial widget-test draft used flutter_test's pumpEventQueue() inside testWidgets(), which hangs indefinitely because testWidgets() runs under a fake-async zone where real Timers never fire; replaced with plain tester.pump() calls (microtasks drain independently of the fake clock) -- this was caught and fixed during this same test-writing pass, not left in place. Full `flutter test` run across the whole repo (114 tests) passed with zero failures and zero skips. No production code was modified -- only new test files.
